definitions.explanation: Indicates the cause or reason for an undesirable outcome. Attaches to nouns (with の), na-adjectives (with な), i-adjectives, and verbs in plain form.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せいで⟦{遅|おく}れた→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: I was late because of the rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寝不足|ねぶそく}→寝不足：07692_nebusoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せいで⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
examples.english: My head hurts because of lack of sleep.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せいで⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧⟦していて→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}わなかった→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧。
examples.english: The road was congested because of construction, and I didn't make it to the meeting in time.

notes:
Derived from {所為|せい} (cause, fault), せいで is used exclusively when the result is negative or undesirable. For positive outcomes, ⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ is used instead.

USAGE:
せいで follows nouns with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧, na-adjectives with な, and plain-form verbs or i-adjectives directly. It can also appear as せい⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (softer, less certain) or in the pattern ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to blame something on).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{名詞|めいし}→名詞：10420_meishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せいで — because of [noun]
- ⟦{動詞|どうし}→動詞：03472_doushi⟧せいで — because [verb]
- せい⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ — perhaps because of
- ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to blame on

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ — thanks to; because of (positive result)
- ⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ — because of (neutral, can be positive or negative)
- ⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧ — due to (formal, neutral cause)
